description: This file implements a negotiation algorithm for Git, managing commit references, marking common commits, and handling revision lists for synchronization.

methods.name: rev_list_push
methods.description: Adds a commit to the revision list if not already marked, parsing it if necessary.

methods.name: clear_marks
methods.description: Clears specific flags from a commit referenced by a ref.

methods.name: mark_common
methods.description: Marks a commit and its ancestors as common, optionally only ancestors.

methods.name: get_rev
methods.description: Retrieves the next revision to send, ignoring common commits.

methods.name: known_common
methods.description: Marks a commit as known to be common.

methods.name: add_tip
methods.description: Adds a commit as a tip in the negotiation process.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Gets the next revision to process.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the negotiator.

methods.name: default_negotiator_init
methods.description: Initializes the negotiator with function pointers and state.
